title: 국립박물관 소장유물 대여 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text: Article 4 (Reporting Loans of Designated Cultural Heritage, etc.) Where a museum director lends museum-held artifacts that are designated cultural heritage or provisionally designated cultural heritage under the Act on Preservation and Utilization of Cultural Heritage, or natural monuments, etc., provisionally designated natural monuments, or provisionally designated scenic sites under the Act on Preservation and Utilization of Natural Heritage, the museum director shall report a change in storage location pursuant to Article 40 (1) 5 of the relevant Act. <Amended on May 27, 2020; June 14, 2024>
